attributes.board_name: Rhode Island Board of Pharmacy (RI Department of Health)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses sponsored by a recognized provider (ACPE, Board-approved, other state boards, AMA Category I)
rules.alternatives: Technician II must also maintain national certification (e.g. PTCB) to renew.
rules.audit_note: Keep CE documentation at least 2 years.
rules.notes: Applies to Pharmacy Technician II (nationally certified); no CE stated for Technician I. 10 hours each calendar year. Technician license renews every 2 years, expiring Dec 31.
